name: flight-strip.png
prompt:
Create flight-strip.png, a clean horizontal storyboard strip of EXACTLY SIX PANELS, one row, left to right, wide 3:1 canvas 3072x1024. Each panel a small readable painted game keyframe with dark blue-black woodland and soft warm ember lighting. Reference image 1 establishes scene/characters, reference image 2 establishes owl flight/child delight. Same round fluffy little brown-grey owl with big round yellow eyes; no camera gaze, owl faces along its motion to LEFT and UP throughout. Orange hooded child and grey long-necked cygnet in brown SIDE satchel appear in last three panels, looking UP at owl, never viewer. Same simple soft stylised 3D shapes, not realism.
Six clearly separated equal-width panels with tiny understated labels in footer:
1 “FLUFF” : close insert owl perched in fork, tiny shoulders scrunch, feathers puff out into round ball, curious head tilt down-left, warm light from visible ember low at edge.
2 “HOP” : tiny feet push from fork, body bobs upward, wings only halfway open, one toe still nearly catches twig, charming clumsy-cute. Small curved pale annotation arrow indicates little upward hop.
3 “OPEN” : owl fully clear of fork, wings spread very wide, feet dangling, round belly, slightly uneven wings, leaning left, arrow left-up.
4 “FLAP” : owl commits to soft downstroke moving left toward child, wings cupped down, body slightly lurches then lifts; tiny flapping shadow on modest outcrop visible behind.
5 “PASS” : owl wings on upstroke just above and past girl's orange hood; girl gazes up smiling, cygnet pops up from satchel with stretched grey neck, warm amber visible ember below, arrow sweeps up-left.
6 “AWAY” : side/back view owl higher, a smaller wing-spread silhouette ascends up and clear of the bare tree crowns through blue night, delicate cold rim; girl and cygnet small at bottom watch it leave, curved path annotation continuing upward.
Pose silhouettes must be distinct: round puff, toe push, full spread, downstroke, upstroke, upward glide. Keep owl cute and round with yellow eyes, no sharp scary brows, not eagle or hawk. Nobody looks at viewer. Six panels total; each contains ONE owl. Annotation arrows are fine pale dotted production drawing marks, NOT wind magic or light sources. Set has exactly two golden veil embers, one foreground by child and one distant by stump. No flames, no towers/slab rocks, no monster shadow. No other text than six short labels.
